assumptions: Cross-regime continuity is semantic and commitment-based; representative micro/molecular/atomic states are bounded local materializations rather than whole-object enumeration.
Source coordinate units are explicit and non-fm structural coordinates are accepted only through exact conversion to integer femtometres with source-space provenance retained.
limitations: Material component ppm is never reinterpreted as mole fraction.
Reaction networks are topology descriptors only; kinetics and thermodynamics are not solved.
Source-backed structure requires explicit provenance and licensing metadata before V2X-12 treats the source claim as eligible.
Computed structural coordinates remain model-derived and never inherit source-backed experimental authority.
Nested V2X-12 per-field caps are independent ceilings subject to the global PX data budget; simultaneous saturation of every nested maximum is not claimed, and oversized compound records fail closed.
No molecular dynamics, reactive molecular dynamics, electron-orbit, orbital, wavefunction or quantum-dynamics claim is made.

fidelity.validity: Bounded source-aware material, tissue/cell organization, representative microstructure, chemistry topology and atomic structural continuity layered over shipping v1 matter providers.
fidelity.resolution: Tissue/cell descriptor bridge plus MATERIAL, MICROSTRUCTURE, MOLECULAR and ATOMIC semantic regimes with explicit finite caps and fail-closed source-unit conversion.
fidelity.uncertainty: Unknown chemistry, unsupported source provenance, global data-budget rejection, unmeasured kinetics and non-classical states remain explicitly unresolved or unsupported.

assumptions: Semantic magnification and normalized display coordinates can communicate regime changes without asserting literal Euclidean zoom or new scientific authority.
Bounded tissue cells and cell compartments can be projected with inherited model store/material units while display placement remains presentation-only.
Cell compartments, membranes, gradients, transport capacities and material-flow topology can be exposed as bounded semantic cues without claiming literal morphology, flux rates or metabolic kinetics.
Reducing a rendering budget must not reposition retained nodes; bounded omission is reported explicitly with available-count and truncation witnesses.
When relation cues exceed the bounded projection limit, deterministic category-preserving projection retains cues from every nonempty relation class before allocating additional slots.
Unknown material, phase and mixture remainders remain explicitly labelled unresolved rather than being presented as known chemistry or phase inventory.
Integer femtometre source coordinates are centered with exact integer arithmetic before bounded conversion to presentation-space numbers, including large safe-integer offsets.
Biological presentation revalidates relation bounds and compartment endpoints; COARSE_MODEL_ONLY cannot be upgraded through injected rich relation cues or provider material-commitment claims.

Regime-local journey presentation revalidates nested descriptor caps and source/computed atomic authority before projection; an explicit empty source structure never falls back to representative atoms.
limitations: Tissue-cell, material, molecular and biological compartment placement is presentation-only.
Tissue phenotype/store-unit cues are inherited bounded model descriptors and are not measured cell observations or physical morphology.
Microstructure phases, interfaces and defects plus mixture, bond and reaction relations are semantic cues rather than simulated geometry or dynamics.
Fixed-point structural coordinates are centered and normalized for display while original integer coordinates, source-space coordinates and units remain separately retained.
Computed atomic structure is explicitly distinguished from source-backed experimental structure.
Node and relation budgets can omit otherwise available bounded cues; omission is exposed through truncation witnesses and is never presented as a complete inventory.
Dense relation classes cannot silently starve every cue from another nonempty class; per-category projected and omitted counts remain explicit.
Tissue and biological presentation validates deterministic identity/ordinal uniqueness and material-unit closure before emitting cues; invalid closures fail closed.
Oversized biological relation arrays, invalid compartment endpoints and coarse-state authority injection fail closed at the presentation boundary.
Mismatched atomic source authority, site/provenance counts, duplicate source-site identity and out-of-cap nested journey descriptors fail closed before projection.
The provider owns no shared camera, scale, selection, input or canonical mutation authority.

fidelity.validity: Authority-labelled bounded presentation spanning tissue cells, provider-supported cell organization, material composition, microstructure descriptors, molecular topology and atomic structures.
fidelity.resolution: TISSUE to CELL semantic continuity plus at most 256 provider nodes and 128 semantic relations per projected representation, with stable retained-node placement, category-preserving relation projection, explicit truncation witnesses and fail-closed regime-local input validation.
fidelity.uncertainty: Source-backed, computed/model-derived, unresolved, presentation-only and budget-truncated states remain distinguishable; no visualization upgrades model authority.
